title: Upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card pilot
summary: Learn about the upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card, a verifiable credential that uses face verification to reduce identity theft risk.
intro:
Service NSW is piloting an upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card at the Auburn, Blacktown and Parramatta Service NSW Centres.

The upgraded NSW Digital Photo Card is a verifiable credential that reduces the risk of identity theft by using a face verification to ensure only you can use it.

Verifiable credentials are enhanced digital credentials that align to a global standard that allows licences and ID documents to be verified and accepted more widely. Verifiable credentials can support selective disclosure, which reduces oversharing of sensitive information and provides greater protection of your privacy and personal information.
who_can_apply: The latest version of the Service NSW app on an iPhone or Android device
A valid NSW Digital Photo Card within the NSW Digital Wallet
Having participated in the NSW Digital Photo Card trial
what_you_need: A physical NSW Photo Card or NSW Driver Licence, plus 2 other accepted identity documents
A device with a front camera to complete a face verification
To complete the upgrade, identity and face verification will be required

how_to_steps.text: Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) and/or Responsible Conduct of Gambling (RCG) card applications and renewals
mobility parking permit applications and renewals
a range of other driving and transport services.
Face verification ensures only you can add it to your Digital Wallet and share it.
In the future it can be used more widely within NSW, Australian states and territories and internationally.
It gives you more control of the personal information you share.

faqs.a: It is a verifiable credential that uses face verification to ensure only you can use it, reducing the risk of identity theft.

faqs.a: The upgraded card is being piloted at the Auburn, Blacktown and Parramatta Service NSW Centres.
